title: Q-STALL-unlearn-beat: clock unlearn-beat stopped and restarts did not take
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** clock `unlearn-beat` stopped (last beat age None s, expected every 3600 s) and 2 restarts did not take
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation resilience --probe unlearn-beat
**Status:** closed

RESILIENCE-1: find why the clock stopped (disabled schedule, failing job, dead route), fix the cause, and add a second independent trigger so it cannot stop silently again. Escalated through the queue, never by email.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation resilience --probe unlearn-beat` reports ticking.

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T04:11:32Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
